public_rationale: OpenAI's August 1 announcement, archived on August 3, reports selected mathematical results from an internal version of Astra and provides no broader practical-task evaluation [e1]. Those results do not establish its reliability across open-ended real-world tasks, supporting the observation that the degree of that capability remained unsettled by the disclosed evidence through August 3 [e1].
limitations: This assesses what public evidence established at publication, not whether Astra was capable of practical work.
The claim specifies no fixed task set or reliability threshold.
The inspected record cannot exclude overlooked public evaluations or establish the results of private testing.
